weakness: Router management reachable from subscriber networks (and from the internet until 2026-07-23); no logging at managed interfaces
source: P07 assessment (SC-07a. objectives); P03 G-050; P01 R-001
remediation_plan: Rework router filters so only the management VLAN and VPN reach device management; remote log server at SITE-1
milestones: 2026-07-23 internet access blocked (done); 2026-09-15 filters reworked in the maintenance window; 2026-12-31 log server running
resources_required: Owner time; small log server about $300

weakness: Edge router two releases behind a critical advisory; no advisory tracking, firmware deadlines, or change log
source: P07 assessment (SI-02 objectives); P03 G-048, G-049; P01 R-001
remediation_plan: Update router and switch firmware; subscribe to vendor and CISA KEV advisories; quarterly firmware review; critical updates within 30 days; test on the spare router; change log
milestones: 2026-09-15 router updated; 2026-10-31 advisory subscriptions and change log in use

weakness: No MFA on the VoIP reseller portal; router admin by password only
source: P07 assessment (IA-02(01)); P03 G-021; P01 R-002
remediation_plan: Turn on VoIP portal MFA; named router admin accounts over the VPN with key-based sign-in
milestones: 2026-09-15 portal MFA on and tested; 2026-10-31 router named accounts

weakness: AI assistant identifies text-line users by account number and ZIP code; account change notices only for password changes
source: P07 assessment (IA-08); P03 G-023, G-026; P01 R-003
remediation_plan: Limit CPNI to signed-in portal sessions; text line answers outages and general questions only; turn on notices for new online accounts, email of record, and service address changes
milestones: 2026-07-22 call history off on the text line (done); 2026-10-31 assistant limits and notices configured and retested

weakness: Default credentials on a new access point; shared and unchanged device and installer passwords; passwords saved in the browser
source: P07 assessment (IA-05 objectives); P01 R-004, R-015
remediation_plan: Password manager; unique access point passwords set from the controller; post-install checklist for the contractor; change all shared passwords; named installer account
milestones: 2026-07-23 SITE-3 defaults changed (done); 2026-10-31 all devices checked and shared passwords replaced
resources_required: Password manager about $40 a year; owner time

weakness: Router and switch configuration copy 4 months old, single copy, first restore attempt failed
source: P07 assessment (CP-09b. and CP-09d.[03]); P03 G-052; P01 R-011
remediation_plan: Weekly automatic configuration copy of router and switch to the business file storage; restore test on the spare router twice a year
milestones: 2026-10-31 weekly copy running; 2026-11-30 first successful restore test

weakness: No review of SaaS sign-in histories or router logs
remediation_plan: Monthly review on the first business day using a one-page checklist; weekly for 3 months after any incident

weakness: No reporting time or reporting path for CPNI breaches, CALEA compromises, or 911 center outages
source: P07 assessment (IR-06 objectives); P03 G-029 to G-034, G-039, G-044; P01 R-006
remediation_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and matrix; find the FCC reporting facility link and FBI and USSS contacts; confirm the county 911 center outage contact
milestones: 2026-08-31 runbook adopted (done); 2026-09-30 contacts printed and runbook walked through with the consultant

weakness: No security or CPNI terms with the VoIP provider, AI assistant vendor, or tower contractor; oversight only for the billing vendor
source: P07 assessment (SA-09 objectives); P03 G-017, G-053; P01 R-013
remediation_plan: Vendor list with CPNI access and review dates; written terms for the contractor; breach notice terms requested from the VoIP provider; P10 review of the assistant
milestones: 2026-10-31 vendor list and contractor terms; next VoIP agreement renewal for breach notice terms
resources_required: Owner time; counsel review about 1 hour
